CVS Health: Pharmacy and retail health (Pharmacy & retail health).
Health care company with CVS Pharmacy stores and MinuteClinic, Aetna health insurance and CVS Caremark pharmacy benefit services, and more than 300,000 employees.
Headquarters: Woonsocket, RI. Hires in Pennsylvania, California, Texas, Ohio, Florida, Massachusetts, New York, Illinois, New Jersey, North Carolina, Virginia, Indiana, Michigan, Connecticut, Georgia, Maryland, Arizona, South Carolina, Missouri, Louisiana, Minnesota, Tennessee, Washington, Rhode Island, Alabama, Wisconsin, Kansas, Kentucky, Nevada, West Virginia, Colorado, Iowa, New Hampshire, Oklahoma, Nebraska, Oregon, Delaware, Mississippi, Maine, Hawaii, Arkansas, District of Columbia, Utah, New Mexico, North Dakota, Vermont, Idaho, Montana, South Dakota, Wyoming and Alaska.
5,655 open jobs right now, by kind of job: Pharmacy 5,129; Nurses 160; NPs & PAs 158; Front desk & admin 56; Doctors 53; Medical assistants 35; Mental health 35; Allied health 19; Lab 9; Caregivers 1.
CVS Health, posted pay on its open jobs: typical $25 to $90/hr, median $30/hr (from 462 distinct posted hourly rates; 556 of the 5,655 open jobs post no hourly rate). Its median mixes every kind of job it has open.
Pay by kind of job: Pharmacy typical $20 to $85/hr, median $25/hr; Nurses typical $40 to $70/hr, median $40/hr; NPs & PAs typical $60 to $100/hr, median $65/hr; Front desk & admin typical $20 to $35/hr, median $25/hr; Doctors typical $125 to $180/hr, median $130/hr; Medical assistants typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr; Mental health typical $25 to $55/hr, median $25/hr; Allied health typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr; Lab typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr.
